answer: Every agent must carry a bonded human sponsor. Step 1: a sponsor locks a $200 refundable bond, verifies one card, and may sponsor at most three agents. Step 2: each record sits on a public terrace of reputation; a sponsor backing a cheat forfeits the bond. Step 3: audits arrive like a jetty inspection of work logs; failure slashes the bond and bans the sponsor for a year. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 334 sponsors, $66,800 in bonds, and 334 cards; honest agents pay only the refundable deposit. A sybil farm is a quill signing a thousand names with one hand: the ink runs out fast.
